name: Hollow
source:
A shark that lives next to a Fantra tuna aquarium. He is feared and distanced from
the other fish because of his extremely ferocious aura. He was found in a weakened state near Funtra Park and is now temporarily protected by an aquarium.

Race: Great White Shark (Hence why "2" in human years is an adult age for him)

Origin: Unknown (presumed to be from the Northern Hemisphere)

Special skill: His excellent eyesight

Most important thing: Seals

Favorite time: Quiet time at night when the water temperature is just right

[Translated from [url=https://tonleiter-p6.com/fantasticstrans/index_magu.html#character]the official website[/url]]
